SELECT
    t.row_id
FROM $$rows_in_scope AS t
WHERE
    load_source = 'ALPHA'
    AND (
        source_system_identifier IS NULL
        OR TRIM(source_system_identifier) = ''
        OR source_id IS NULL
        OR NOT source_id IN (
            SELECT
                source_id
            FROM ds.sources
            WHERE
                is_active
        )
    )

SELECT
    t.row_id
FROM $$rows_in_scope AS t
WHERE
    load_source = 'ALPHA' AND (
        handle_time < 0 OR work_time < 0
    )

SELECT
    t.row_id
FROM $$rows_in_scope AS t
WHERE
    load_source = 'ALPHA'
    AND (
        NOT customer_rating IS NULL AND NOT customer_rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    )

SELECT
    t.row_id
FROM $$rows_in_scope AS t

    AND (
        agent_id IS NULL

        OR support_area_id IS NULL
        OR interaction_status IS NULL

        OR customer_type_id IS NULL
        OR handle_time IS NULL

    )

SELECT
